observations: Black vintage-style sewing machine head with gold-colored decals.
The arm of the machine has 'BEAUTIFUL' and 'MADE IN THE PEOPLE'S REPUBLIC OF CHINA' printed on it.
The machine is mounted on a wooden table with a hinged extension leaf.
The table is supported by a black cast-iron treadle stand with a foot pedal.
A drive belt connects the treadle wheel to the machine's handwheel.
Photo 1 shows significant chipping or delamination on the front edge of the wooden table.
The metal components show some signs of surface wear and dust.

claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows the treadle stand and foot pedal used for manual operation.

risks.risk: The internal mechanism may be seized or timing may be off.
risks.proof: A video showing the handwheel being turned and the needle bar moving smoothly.

risks.risk: The shuttle and bobbin case (essential parts) may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the underside of the machine or the open slide plate showing the bobbin area.

risks.risk: The wooden table may have structural rot or further delamination not visible in the wide shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the table edges and the underside of the wood.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation (sewing a piece of fabric).
Close-up photo of the bobbin area with the slide plate open.
Clear photos of the table's wooden surfaces to assess the extent of the peeling/damage.
response.reason: The item is a common 'Beautiful' brand manual treadle sewing machine. While there is visible damage to the table and the mechanical state is unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value for a non-functional unit with a damaged stand.
